subject: Aeterna GCP MAP + procurement checklist and invoice routing
messages:
From: Karan Singh <k.singh@aeterna.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aeterna.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + procurement checklist for GCP private offer

Hi Hannah / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — Aeterna's cloud procurement team wants a compact mutual action plan (MAP) we can attach to the internal approval packet. Goal is to pin acceptance criteria, technical eval items, and a clear billing/invoice path so Finance can sign off next week.

High-level asks from our side:
- Exact billing entity and invoice cadence (monthly vs net-30 vs milestone)
- Legal primary contact and PO process for private offers on GCP marketplace
- Technical acceptance tests (short list we can run during the eval window)
- Any required SOC2/evidence link for procurement review

We're looking at a 2-week eval window (start 9/13) and would like a one-page MAP plus a short SOW stub to circulate to Finance. Can you share a draft MAP and SOW by EOD 9/8?

CCing procurement so they see timing.

Thanks,
Karan Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Aeterna Health

---
Attachment(s): none in this message
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karan Singh <k.singh@aeterna.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement checklist for GCP private offer

Hi Karan — thanks for the clear checklist.

I've attached a short MAP (one sheet) and an SOW stub that match the items you listed. Key notes up-front:
- Billing: Redwood invoices the customer billing entity on a monthly invoice for committed Dedicated capacity; for marketplace private offers we can route via the customer's GCP billing account with net-30 payment terms. If you prefer vendor-invoiced (Redwood) rather than marketplace-invoice routing we can also do that — please flag.
- Legal: Primary contact for contract routing is Kimberly Park (cc'd). She can accept redlines and route to our legal team.
- Tech acceptance: included a 5-point checklist (latency targets, sample prompts, data retention verifications, and security scan).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report link included in MAP (short URL in the sheet).

Proposed next steps:
1) You review MAP + SOW and drop comments in the Drive link I included in the file.
2) Schedule a 30-minute sync on 9/9 for Finance + Procurement to confirm invoice path.
3) We start the eval 9/13 and run the acceptance tests during week 1.

If you want us to prepare a Marketplace Private Offer configuration (SKU mapping + invoice routing instructions) we can include that as a short appendix.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Megan Li <megan.li@aeterna.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karan Singh <k.singh@aeterna.com>, procurement@aeterna.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement checklist for GCP private offer

Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround and the one-pager. A few procurement notes after internal review:

- Finance prefers Marketplace invoice routing to keep the spend on our cloud bill; they asked for a concrete example invoice line (SKU + unit) to attach to the packet. Can you provide an example monthly invoice row for the Dedicated node commit?
- Procurement needs a clarification in the SOW about data residency for logs (we require retention in US only).
- Legal asked whether Redwood supports purchase orders (POs) and whether the PO should reference the GCP private offer ID or Redwood's contract number.

We can do the 30-minute sync 9/9 at 10:00am PT — Karan and I will invite Finance (cc'd). If you can add an invoice example and a PO guidance note to the MAP before the call that would be perfect.

Thanks,
Megan Li
Sr. Manager, Vendor Ops
Aeterna Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 9 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + procurement checklist for GCP private offer

Megan / Karan — thanks for the feedback and the call this morning. Follow-ups from our side:

- Attached is an updated MAP (v1.1) with an "Example Invoice Row" (SKU: RW-Dedicated-1xA100, Qty: 1, UnitPrice: $18,000/mo) so Finance can see the formatting we expect on a marketplace invoice.
- SOW now includes explicit language for US-only log retention and a short acceptance script for the security/retention item.
- PO guidance: Redwood accepts POs referencing either the GCP Private Offer ID or the Redwood contract number; we recommend referencing the private offer ID so marketplace billing reconciliation is straightforward.
- On billing path: if you'd like Redwood to issue vendor invoices instead of marketplace routing we can accommodate but that will shift billing to Redwood's accounts receivable (still net-30). We called this out in the "Billing Options" appendix.

Next steps:
- Aeterna to confirm chosen invoice path by 9/13 (start of eval).
- If marketplace routing: procurement confirms the GCP billing account and we provide SKU mapping for the private offer by 9/12.
- If vendor invoices: we place an SOW-based invoice schedule in the contract and Finance confirms PO/terms.

Marcus (cc) will help with the SKU mapping files and provide the marketplace configuration snippet if needed.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
